name: Shadow Panther Will

acquire.equipPiece: A single ragged shadow-smoke tail-sash at the hip that flicks behind the runner like a panther tail (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a panther-humanoid wrapped in ragged shadow armor: pointed cat ears with a brow-guard, acid-yellow slit eyes, clawed gauntlets, digitigrade crouching legs with spiked greaves, a whip tail and a torn shadow mantle; a shadow claw-blade grows from the right hand. Drains mana extremely fast (canon drawback), the highest drain in the roster.

equip.weapon: A long shadow claw-blade (katar) formed on the right hand from the dark; it makes no sound when it cuts.
equip.armor: Ragged black shadow-plate: a torn silence mantle over the shoulders, cat-eared brow-guard, clawed gauntlets and spiked greaves; violet piping so it can be seen.
equip.hair_eyes: Black hair swept back into a ragged ruff, glowing acid-yellow slit eyes.
equip.aura: Violet-black smoke with ragged edges peeling off the body and a muffled ring of silence under the feet.

beastNote: Shadow Panther (A-class; the wiki rates Virion's panther AA)
lore: A panther of moonless dark that hushes wind and sound until it is only a rumour; the holder first borrows its reflexes, then becomes the silence it hunts in.
pitch: The Shadow Panther is a black cat of the dark that erases wind and sound around it. Acquire keeps you human, blurring in violet afterimages with one shadow tail-sash flicking at your hip. Integrate (Full armoured form) turns you into a panther-humanoid in ragged shadow armor with a claw-blade, and its price is the fastest mana drain of any will.
untrained: An untrained holder's own shadow tears loose in pain: ragged shadow flickers off the body, hearing drops out in short bursts and every dash adds extra strain; the form burns mana so fast that an unbalanced will can wreck the core and kill the host. The will lies dormant in the core until it is forcibly awakened; training both the holder's own core and the beast core is the cure.

spirit.echo: A crouched panther beastman in ragged shadow armor: cat ears, glowing slit eyes, clawed gauntlets, digitigrade stalking stance, whip tail, torn shadow edges and one claw-blade; the black body needs a violet rim and yellow eyes to be seen.
spirit.look: A near-black orb whose surface frays into ragged smoke, with a thin violet rim light so it reads on dark ground and two slit acid-yellow glints like cat eyes opening in it.
